integrity: Exact analytic proof backed by standalone finite checks; numerical checks not treated as proof of limits. Source publication date uses first arXiv public version.
scientific_limitations: Annealed uniformly tagged query; fixed d and beta>1; neither pointwise/quenched nor high-dimensional. No independent priority audit and no claimed novelty of the classical local limit theorem.
title: Sharp shape-regularity rarity and volume decoupling for uniformly tagged random-split cells
